App.Title: Compendium Manager
App.ToggleType: Toggle whether this type is managed
App.DeletionsHint: Deleting from a mirror pack does not remove the shared copy until you confirm it here. Keeping a document restores it on the next sync.

Sync.PullDone: Pulled {created} new and {updated} updated document(s) from the shared library.
Sync.PushDone: Pushed {created} new and {updated} updated document(s) to the shared library.
Sync.PullFailed: Could not finish pulling from the shared library. See the console for details.
Sync.PushFailed: Could not finish pushing to the shared library. See the console for details.
Sync.ConflictsResolved: {count} document(s) changed in both places. The shared version was kept and your local version was copied into the _conflicts folder.

Deletions.ConfirmBody: {count} document(s) will be permanently removed from the shared library, in this world and the other one.
Deletions.Applied: Removed {count} document(s) from the shared library.

Merge.Title: Merge a compendium into the shared library
Merge.Intro: Choose an existing compendium to bring into the shared library. Nothing is written until you review the report and confirm, and nothing is ever deleted from either side.
Merge.NoAdoptable: No compendiums are available to merge in this world.
Merge.Name: Document
Merge.NoSource: Choose a compendium to merge first.
Merge.NoTarget: There is no shared pack for that document type.
Merge.AnalyseFailed: The dry run failed. See the console for details.
Merge.NothingToDo: Every entry is set to skip, so there is nothing to write.
Merge.ConfirmBody: {count} document(s) will be written from {source} into {target}.
Merge.ConfirmNoDelete: Nothing will be deleted. You can run this again at any time.

Errors.WrongSystem: Compendium Manager only supports the {system} system and is inactive in this world.
Errors.SystemMismatch: The shared library was created for the {recorded} system but this world runs {current}. Syncing is disabled to protect your data.
Errors.VersionDrift: The shared library was last used with system version {recorded}; this world runs {current}. Syncing continues, but keeping both worlds on the same version is recommended.
Errors.MissingPacks: These shared packs are missing from the module install: {packs}.
Errors.StartupFailed: Compendium Manager could not start. See the console for details.

AutoSync.Name: Sync automatically
AutoSync.Hint: Push edits made in the mirror packs to the shared library shortly after you make them.

SyncDebounce.Name: Auto sync delay (seconds)
SyncDebounce.Hint: How long to wait after your last edit before pushing to the shared library.

SyncPackOwnership.Name: Carry pack ownership between worlds
SyncPackOwnership.Hint: Pack ownership is a per-world setting. With this on, the ownership you configure in one world is applied to the managed packs in the other.

ConfirmDeletions.Name: Confirm deletions
ConfirmDeletions.Hint: Ask before removing anything from the shared library. Leaving this on is strongly recommended.

DuplicateMatching.Name: Duplicate detection
DuplicateMatching.Hint: How hard the merge wizard looks for content that already exists in the shared library.
DuplicateMatching.Source: Same id or original compendium entry
DuplicateMatching.Name_: Same id, original entry, or name and type

Debug.Name: Debug logging
Debug.Hint: Write verbose [compendium-manager] messages to the browser console.

Manager.Label: Open Manager
